gaps.info: Synovial fluid WBC count, differential, Gram stain, and culture results
gaps.discriminates: Septic arthritis (typically >50,000/μL, often with positive culture) vs. gout/pseudogout (crystal-positive, lower WBC in uncomplicated cases) vs. inflammatory arthritis (lower WBC, sterile)

gaps.info: Ultrasound findings: presence/absence of joint effusion and power Doppler hyperemia
gaps.discriminates: Septic arthritis (effusion + hyperemia) vs. non-inflammatory causes (e.g., occult fracture without effusion) vs. chronic arthropathy (effusion without hyperemia)

gaps.info: Fever or systemic symptoms (e.g., chills, tachycardia, malaise)
gaps.discriminates: Septic arthritis (often systemic toxicity) vs. crystal arthropathies (typically no fever unless complicated) vs. early rheumatoid flare (less acute systemic response)
